name: DDO 82 (Hubble)
blurb: DDO 82, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ddo82-hubble
story: A loose haze of stars in the M81 Group, DDO 82 still hints at spiral structure, though gravitational tugs from its neighbors have blurred it.

claims.text: DDO 82 is a dwarf irregular galaxy, classified Sm (Magellanic spiral)
DDO 82 is also known as UGC 5692
DDO 82 is part of the M81 Group
It shows a hint of structure, made less evident by gravitational interactions
